sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('e21e24d5-0535-4962-b9ed-7957fe4ed3db', 'a844e68a-1462-40e4-be5e-f56214906eb9') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment
